title: Pokemon TCG Basic Fire Energy 010 Regular Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The product is a Common Basic Fire Energy card from the Pokémon TCG set Sv07: Stellar Crown. It has a Regular finish and features the Energy attribute. The card is in English and has the card number 010. It is a Basic Energy card used in gameplay. It is not autographed. The manufacturer is The Pokémon Company.
